meta.promptText: India mein shaadi ke liye budget mein online konsi sarees kharidun?

response.text:
Agar India mein shaadi ke liye budget mein sundar saree kharidni hai, toh meri recommendation hai ki **Banarasi silk-blend, Bandhani, embroidered georgette aur zari-border sarees** dekho. Inmein festive aur wedding look mil sakta hai bina bahut zyada paise kharch kiye.

Maine online options check kiye hain. Myntra, AJIO aur Amazon par ₹500–₹3,000 ke aas-paas options mil rahe hain; prices aur discounts badal sakte hain.
